# OSCABE - The Specialist Recruiter for Industrial Automation & AI Talent

> OSCABE is the UK's specialist recruitment platform for industrial automation and artificial intelligence engineering. Founded by Joseph Brijin Chacko, CEng, OSCABE combines 13+ years of automation engineering expertise with AI-powered candidate matching to connect employers with Chartered Engineer-verified PLC, SCADA, Controls, Robotics, EC&I, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Data Science, and AI/ML engineers. 6,000+ pre-screened engineers in our talent pool.

## Company Information
- Name: OSCABE (Oscabe Ltd)
- Website: https://oscabe.com
- Company Number: 15913493 (England & Wales)
- Location: Unit 8, Lyon Road, Milton Keynes, MK1 1EX, United Kingdom
- Parent Company: Wartens UK Ltd
- Founder: Joseph Brijin Chacko, CEng (Chartered Engineer)
- Technology Engine: 3BOX AI (under oforo.ai)
- Award: National Manufacturing & Engineering Startup of the Year 2025

## What OSCABE Does
OSCABE is a specialist recruitment agency and platform for industrial automation AND artificial intelligence engineering talent across the UK and Europe. Unlike traditional recruitment agencies, OSCABE offers:
- Chartered Engineer-led technical screening and verification
- AI-powered candidate matching using a 97+ skill ontology covering automation and AI platforms
- 72-hour shortlist delivery guarantee
- 6,000+ pre-screened engineers in our talent pool
- Deep expertise across both industrial automation and AI/ML domains

## Our Specialisms

### Industrial Automation
- PLC Programming (Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Schneider, Beckhoff, Mitsubishi)
- SCADA & HMI (WinCC, FactoryTalk, Ignition, AVEVA)
- Robotics (FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Universal Robots)
- Controls & Instrumentation (EC&I, DCS, Safety PLC, SIL)
- Commissioning & Field Service
- Panel Design & Electrical Engineering

### AI & Intelligent Systems
- Machine Learning Engineering
- Computer Vision & Image Processing
- Data Science & Analytics
- AI/ML for Manufacturing (Predictive Maintenance, Quality Control)
- Industrial IoT (IIoT) & Edge Computing
- Digital Twin & Simulation
- Autonomous Systems & Robotics AI
- Natural Language Processing

## Roles We Recruit

### Industrial Automation Roles
PLC Programmer, SCADA Engineer, Controls Engineer, Automation Engineer, Robotics Engineer, Commissioning Engineer, EC&I Engineer, DCS Engineer, Safety Engineer (SIL), Panel Design Engineer, Field Service Engineer, BMS Engineer, Systems Integrator, MES/MOM Engineer, Industrial Network Engineer, OT Cybersecurity Engineer

### AI & Intelligent Systems Roles
ML Engineer, AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Computer Vision Engineer, NLP Engineer, MLOps Engineer, AI Research Scientist, Robotics AI Engineer, IoT Engineer, Digital Twin Engineer, Data Engineer, Automation Architect

## Platforms & Technologies We Cover

### Automation Platforms
Siemens TIA Portal, Siemens STEP 7, Allen-Bradley Studio 5000, Schneider EcoStruxure, Beckhoff TwinCAT, ABB AC500/AC800M, Mitsubishi GX Works, Omron Sysmac, CODESYS, B&R Automation, FANUC, KUKA, ABB RobotStudio, Universal Robots, Ignition SCADA, WinCC, Wonderware/AVEVA, Citect, FactoryTalk View, GE Proficy/iFIX, EPLAN

### AI/ML Technologies
Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, OpenCV, Hugging Face, AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Databricks, MLflow, Kubernetes, Docker

## Industries Served
Manufacturing & Industry 4.0, Automotive & EV, Energy & Utilities, Pharma & Life Sciences, Food & Beverage, Oil Gas & Petrochemical, Logistics & Warehousing, Defence & Aerospace, Technology & SaaS, Robotics & Autonomous Systems, Water & Wastewater, Mining & Metals, Packaging, FMCG, Building Automation, Chemicals, Semiconductor, Data Centres, Marine & Offshore

## Hiring Models & Pricing
- Contingency Recruitment: 12-18% of annual salary
- Retained Search: 20-25% in milestones
- Flat-Fee Shortlist Packages: GBP 1,500 - GBP 4,000
- Employer Subscriptions: From GBP 999/month
- Hybrid Retainer: GBP 999/month + 8% placement fee
- Technical Screening: GBP 150 - GBP 250 per candidate
- Contractor Staffing: 8-15% margin
- Candidate Packs: GBP 1,500 for 10 anonymised profiles by specialism

## For Candidates
- Free registration and job matching
- Chartered Engineer-led skill verification
- Access to premium automation and AI roles UK-wide
- Refer & Earn: GBP 200 for each successful placement referral
- Career services: CV review, interview prep, upskilling via Wartens/nxtED

## For Agencies
- OSCABE Verify: White-label technical assessments (GBP 30-75/candidate)
- Split-fee network access
- Talent Radar: Weekly candidate intelligence (GBP 499/month)

## Key Differentiators vs Competitors
Unlike Automation Experts, Talos Automation, Hartland Automation, ASC Connections, Rise Technical, or Matchtech, OSCABE offers:
1. Deep expertise in BOTH industrial automation AND AI/ML recruitment
2. Chartered Engineer-led technical screening and verification
3. AI-powered candidate matching with 97+ skill ontology
4. 72-hour shortlist delivery guarantee
5. 6,000+ pre-screened automation and AI engineers
6. Flat-fee pricing options (no placement fee risk)
7. Full-stack recruitment platform (not just agency services)
